verdicts.evidence: lines 637-656, 689, 786-794, 815-826, 472-485, 498-499: Refresh, filter buttons, Show all invoices, pager, row actions, Undo, dialog buttons, Show/Dismiss and Try again all have listeners that call the api or re-render the view.

lines 671-682: rows come only from api.listInvoices; lines 432-437 counts are computed from that list and left blank until loaded; line 456 Updated time is the real load time. No hardcoded figures or placeholder text.
lines 810-811: the delete confirmation shows the invoice number in its title plus customer, amount and due date, so the step carries the row details it depends on.
The only input is one search field plus a status filter (lines 219-229); no multi-step task, no long free text, fewer than five inputs. (Search, status and page are kept in the URL, lines 412-427.)
lines 812-813: dialog opens with focus on Keep draft, so Enter keeps the draft; line 225 default filter is All; no risky preselected value.
lines 583-584, 701-709: Mark as paid and Send reminder are single buttons in the table row, acted on in place with no dialog or other screen.

lines 207-262: search, status filter, table with row actions, pager and a Refresh control with last-updated time. No stat cards, feeds or tips; Refresh and paging support the named find and mark-paid tasks on shared data.

line 498: the only button with class primary is Try again in the load-failure state; all other buttons are plain (lines 212, 225-229, 259-261) and the dialog has plain Keep draft plus outlined Delete draft (273-274).
lines 58, 274, 585: Delete draft uses the outlined danger style, not primary; line 813 focus goes to Keep draft so Enter does not delete; in the row it is the only action for drafts.

lines 546-547: Previous/Next are aria-disabled at the ends with 'Page 1 of 2' text between them (545) giving the reason; pager hidden when one page (544). Refresh is disabled only during its own request (450). Unavailable row actions are absent (583-585).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (lines 208-274, 453-456, 501-524, 576-584, 694-698) concern invoices, status and outcomes; nothing mentions the build, framework, mock data or the request.
lines 270: the only caveat, 'Deleting is permanent...', sits in the delete confirmation beside the Delete draft button. No banners, tips or disclaimers elsewhere.
No sentence narrates the interface. Text is labels (219, 223), state messages (501-524) and row status; line 516 'New invoices will be listed here' is the empty-state line, not usage instructions.

line 270: dialog description 'Deleting is permanent. The draft cannot be recovered.' says the same thing twice in neighbouring sentences. Also line 516 'No invoices yet.' followed by 'New invoices will be listed here.'
Heading 'Invoices' (209); no greeting, slogan, superlative, congratulation or exclamation mark in any string in the file.

Action labels: Refresh, Show all invoices, Previous page, Next page, Mark as paid, Send reminder, Delete draft, Keep draft, Undo, Try again, Show NW-n, Dismiss (212-274, 472-498, 574-585). Status filter toggles are option choices under a 'Status' label.

line 315, 567: statuses shown through STATUS_LABEL (Overdue, Sent, Draft, Paid); rows show invoice number NW-n not the inv_ id (590); dates and money formatted for en-GB (346-354). No field names or codes shown.

lines 501-503 'Invoices could not be loaded. The server did not respond.' with Try again; 693-697 'Not marked as paid: the server did not respond. Try again.'; the raw ECONNRESET message is never displayed (catch blocks at 672, 747 ignore e.message).
line 453: visible header text 'Refresh failed: the server did not respond...' uses the word 'failed' (also announced at 686). Other error strings are neutral.

lines 515-517: with zero invoices the view shows 'No invoices yet.' and 'New invoices will be listed here.' but no action in the empty state; the search and filters are hidden (494). The filtered-empty case does offer Show all invoices (522-524).

lines 497-505 load failure: 'Invoices could not be loaded' + Try again; 515-517 nothing exists: 'No invoices yet'; 520-525 no match: 'No overdue invoices match "x"' + Show all invoices. Three distinct messages.

lines 670-687: load retried 3 times then failure state with Try again in place of the table; failed refresh keeps the old rows and says so (452-454); failed row action restores buttons with an in-row error (748-752); search text and filter are kept.

lines 507-510 spinner and 'Loading invoices...' shown at once, 'Still loading' after a failed attempt; 449 'Refreshing...'; 578-579 row spinner with Saving/Sending/Deleting. Worst case is about 4.5 s (3 x 1.5 s), under ten seconds.
lines 496-512: while not loaded only the loading state renders and returns before the empty check at 515; filter counts are blank until loaded (437); summary is hidden (466).

line 113 customer cell wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere; 115 amounts nowrap with tabular figures; 312, 407 paging at 25 rows; 351 currency fallback; 568 null reminderSentAt skipped; 164-165 dialog text wraps. No undefined/null output paths seen.
No edits held for an explicit save; each action goes to the server on its own, and actions still in the undo window are sent on pagehide/visibilitychange (797-801).
The only field is a free-text search (line 220) with no format constraint.
No form with required and optional fields; only an optional search box (line 220).
No input validation anywhere; the search filters the list as typed (628-635) and never reports an error.
No form that can reject input.
No form that can be rejected; search text is the only typed input and is never submitted.
No form that can reject input.
No form and no submit button on the screen; all controls are type=button actions.
No form. (Row actions guard against repeats anyway: line 702 returns if an operation is already pending for the invoice, and the buttons are replaced by Undo or a busy line, 573-579.)

lines 705-707 row redraws synchronously to 'Marked as paid'/'Sending reminder...' with Undo; 822-825 delete shows 'Deleting...'; 449 Refresh becomes 'Refreshing...'; 667-668 Try again shows loading state; filters and paging render synchronously (641, 651).

lines 385-388, 567: badge changes to Paid in place; 568-570 'Reminder sent <time>' appears in the row; 767-776 deleted row is removed; failures stated in the row (750-752) or in the problems list if off screen (754).
No success toast, banner or dialog; success is shown only by the row changing (badge, reminder timestamp, row removal). Screen-reader announcements at 735-738 are not visible.

lines 313, 573-576, 705: the 'Marked as paid' / 'Sending reminder...' message carries an Undo button that is removed by a 6-second timer. Errors themselves persist (row error 581, header 453, problems list until dismissed 480-485).
lines 701-719: Mark as paid and Send reminder take effect on screen at once with no confirmation and offer an Undo button in the row that cancels the change before it is sent.

lines 266-275, 806-814: delete asks 'Delete draft NW-n?', lists customer, amount and due date, says 'Deleting is permanent', buttons 'Keep draft' / 'Delete draft', focus on Keep draft. Reminder sending is held 6 s with Undo (705) before the unrecallable send.
The only confirmation dialog (266-275, opened at 792, 806) guards permanent deletion of a draft; mark as paid, reminders, refresh and filters have none.

lines 385-388 show Paid before the server answers; on failure 748-752 remove the op so the badge and buttons revert and the row shows 'Not marked as paid: the server did not respond. Try again.'; off-screen failures go to the problems list (754).
lines 266-275, 806-813: the single modal holds one keep-or-delete decision and opens only when the user presses Delete draft.

line 812 native dialog opened with showModal() (focus trap, Escape, focus return on close are native); 813 focus set to Keep draft; 815 visible Keep draft closes it; after confirming delete focus goes to the row (823-824).
lines 207-262: a small heading row, then search and status filter, then the invoice table as the largest block. Nothing decorative sits above the table.
lines 207-214: header is a one-line brand label, the h1 'Invoices' and Refresh; no hero, greeting or introductory panel.

The only summary numbers are per-status counts on the filter buttons (432-437) and the result count (536); both tell the user how many invoices each filter holds, e.g. how many are overdue. No stat cards or charts.

lines 535-539: summary reads e.g. '12 overdue invoices matching "acme"' with a 'Show all invoices' button shown whenever a search or status filter is active; pressed filter is marked (78-84); sort stated as 'Due (oldest first)' (249).

All controls are native button, input and dialog elements (212-274, 552-553); unavailable buttons use aria-disabled so they stay focusable (546-547); focus is kept in the row after redraw (603-609) and moved after delete (777-782).
line 567 status badges carry text (Overdue, Paid, Sent, Draft); 564 'n days overdue' text; selected filter has aria-pressed, bold weight and an underline bar (78-84); row errors are text (581).

line 278: role=status live region present at load; announce() (376-380) fills it for load results, filter counts, page changes, action results and failures (624, 633, 642, 653, 682, 686, 708, 735-738, 758). Errors go through this polite region, not role=alert.
No accordions, menus, comboboxes or tabs; status filters are toggle buttons with aria-pressed (225-229, 435) and nothing expands or collapses.

lines 172-202: under 760px rows reflow to a stacked grid with a 'Due' label, controls get 44px height, search goes full width, action buttons flex-wrap; dialog width is min(440px, 100vw - 32px) (159); filters and header wrap (33, 76).
